entity-type.label: Research Paper
entity-type.description: Academic or technical paper published on arXiv, journal, conference, or preprint server.

entity-type.label: Research Author
entity-type.description: Researcher/author of papers in the scholarly knowledge base.

entity-type.label: Research Institution
entity-type.description: University, lab, company, or organization publishing research.

entity-type.label: Research Topic
entity-type.description: Area of research (e.g., "Large Language Models", "Retrieval-Augmented Generation").

entity-type.label: Research Method
entity-type.description: Technique, algorithm, or approach proposed or validated in research.

entity-type.label: Research Model
entity-type.description: Machine learning model, architecture, or framework described in research.

entity-type.label: Research Dataset
entity-type.description: Dataset used for training, evaluation, or benchmarking in research.

entity-type.label: Research Benchmark
entity-type.description: Standardized evaluation metric, leaderboard, or test suite for research.

entity-type.label: Research Claim
entity-type.description: Assertion or finding made by a paper (requires evidence).

entity-type.label: Research Evidence
entity-type.description: Empirical data, experiment, or proof supporting or refuting a claim.

entity-type.label: Research Experiment
entity-type.description: Controlled test designed to validate or refute a hypothesis.

entity-type.label: Research Result
entity-type.description: Outcome of an experiment or analysis.

entity-type.label: Research Opportunity
entity-type.description: Business or capability opportunity identified from research findings.

entity-type.label: Research Adoption Decision
entity-type.description: Decision to adopt, pilot, reject, or watch a research finding or technique.

relationship.label: proposes
relationship.description: Paper introduces a new method or technique.

relationship.label: introduces
relationship.description: Paper presents a new model or architecture.

relationship.label: uses-dataset
relationship.description: Paper uses a dataset for evaluation or training.

relationship.label: evaluated-on
relationship.description: Paper reports results on a benchmark.

relationship.label: implemented-by-repository
relationship.description: Paper has official or community code implementation.

relationship.label: cites
relationship.description: This paper cites another paper.

relationship.label: cited-by
relationship.description: This paper is cited by another paper.

relationship.label: similar-to
relationship.description: Paper is semantically similar to another (from Connected Papers).

relationship.label: extends
relationship.description: Paper extends or improves on prior work.

relationship.label: replicates
relationship.description: Paper independently replicates or validates prior findings.

relationship.label: contradicts
relationship.description: Paper refutes or contradicts a prior claim.

relationship.label: supports
relationship.description: Paper provides evidence supporting a claim.

relationship.label: supported-by-evidence
relationship.description: Claim is supported by specific evidence.

relationship.label: validated-by-experiment
relationship.description: Claim is validated through controlled experiment.

relationship.label: produced-result
relationship.description: Experiment produced a specific result.

relationship.label: replicated-by
relationship.description: Result has been independently replicated.

relationship.label: enables-capability
relationship.description: Research finding enables a new company capability.

relationship.label: creates-opportunity
relationship.description: Research finding creates a business or capability opportunity.

relationship.label: applicable-to-venture
relationship.description: Research method is applicable to a specific venture.

relationship.label: adoption-status
relationship.description: Company decision on whether to adopt this research.

relationship.label: authored-by
relationship.description: Paper is authored by a researcher.

relationship.label: from-institution
relationship.description: Researcher is affiliated with an institution.

relationship.label: publishes-to
relationship.description: Paper is published on a research source (arXiv, conference, journal).

relationship.label: addresses-topic
relationship.description: Paper addresses a specific research topic.

relationship.label: topic-contains-method
relationship.description: Topic encompasses specific methods.

level.name: SOURCE
level.description: Paper, report, or publication source (arXiv, journal, etc.).

level.name: PAPER
level.description: Published research describing methods, models, claims.

level.name: CLAIM
level.description: Assertion or finding (requires evidence to validate).

level.name: EVIDENCE
level.description: Empirical data supporting or refuting a claim.

level.name: EXPERIMENT
level.description: Controlled test designed to generate evidence.

level.name: VALIDATED_RESULT
level.description: Finding verified through replication and internal testing.

level.name: CAPABILITY
level.description: Validated capability adopted by Company Brain.

level.name: VENTURE_APPLICATION
level.description: Capability generating revenue in a venture.

state.label: Watch
state.description: Monitoring — interesting but not yet validated or applicable.

state.label: Experiment
state.description: Testing — actively running experiments to evaluate applicability.

state.label: Pilot
state.description: Piloting — limited deployment in one venture or workflow.

state.label: Adopted
state.description: Adopted — integrated into standard capabilities and workflows.

state.label: Rejected
state.description: Rejected — evaluated but determined not applicable or effective.

state.label: Superseded
state.description: Superseded — replaced by newer or better approach.
